comment: Third picture of the post is the 36x26 stripboard layout (populated board above, bare cuts/links view below); the first two pictures are a photo of the pedal and its thumbnail. One populated board, read once. The nine 10n are five film (yellow box) and four ceramic. Switch 1 (Mode) is drawn as a DPDT footswitch wired to six board pads, so it is listed as an effect control. Threadle is a 100K wah pot with no taper given.
uncertain: Count of 10K (22) and 100K (15): dense board, tallied from overlapping tiles by coordinates; a miscount of one is possible
rows: matched JFETs (original were PN4302. Test J112 or others)
